summary: Risk-off start led by chips (Nasdaq-100 futures -1% to -1.7%, Taiwan -6%, Kospi -4%) on Nvidia CEO turmoil a day before its earnings; bias stays bearish on semis with TTWO and JNJ as the bullish spots. Update: no change to picks or levels - no intraday quotes found yet, NVDA ~157 (inside its levels), prices approximate.
